name: new-isolated-chat
script: return fetch('/api/v1/rooms/',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000),body:JSON.stringify({title:'Win7 latest main verification',creator_id:'user-admin',member_ids:['user-win7'],is_direct:true,task_session:true,client_request_id:crypto.randomUUID(),locale:'zh'})}).then(async r=>{const room=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw new Error(JSON.stringify(room));window.__mainRoom=room.id;location.hash='#/dms/'+room.id;return {roomID:room.id}})

text: 请只执行一次 exec_command，用 PowerShell 输出 [Environment]::OSVersion.VersionString、Get-Location，再 Write-Output WIN7_MAIN_CHAIN_OK。成功后只回复 WIN7_MAIN_CHAIN_OK。不要执行其他探索或工具。

name: progress-and-stop-placement
script: const p=document.querySelector('.message-row:not(.own) [data-turn-id]');const stop=document.querySelector('.composer-working-stop');if(!p||!stop||!p.closest('.message-row')?.contains(stop)||document.querySelector('.composer > .composer-working'))throw new Error('progress or stop control remained above composer');return {progress:p.textContent,avatar:true,stopInMessage:true,composerDraft:document.querySelector('.composer-editor')?.innerText}

name: native-chain-evidence
script: if(__mainErrors.length)throw new Error(JSON.stringify(__mainErrors));const m=__mainReply;return {room:__mainRoom,status:m.metadata.csgclaw.turn_progress.status,reply:m.content,errors:__mainErrors,mode:document.querySelector('button[aria-label="运行模式"]')?.innerText,tools:m.metadata.csgclaw.turn_progress.items.filter(i=>i.tool).map(i=>({name:i.tool.name,status:i.tool.status,exit:i.tool.exit_code,output:i.tool.output}))}
